svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The client reaches the local execution server. Independent Community hosts serve multiple communities. Cloud hosting management is a planned HTTP connection to the host API, without content access. Marketplace discovery and installation use the same package sources.
